## AppRegistrar.registerManifest() method

Register every operation an app manifest exposes, as passthrough: no contract value types, and each operation's input must hold exactly its command's declared parameters, so any other key is rejected as `VALIDATION_FAILED`<!-- -->.

**Signature:**

```typescript
registerManifest(manifest: AppManifest): void;
```

## Exceptions

`OperationRegistrationError` when the app's route segment is reserved (`RESERVED_APP_ROUTE_SEGMENTS` in `@macts/runtime`<!-- -->), an operation id is already registered, the manifest yields a malformed id or permission, or a resource-scoped get, update or delete command, or an application-scoped delete, declares no identifier parameter (the error names the app and the command). A refused registration adds nothing.
